propositions: CI artifact probe must deterministically walk and import every rebar.* module in the installed wheel, reporting all failures (not fail-fast) to catch subpackage and lazy-import breakage.

Scripts in scripts/ must be importable under their standalone sys.path contract (without ambient sys.path pollution from sibling scripts or test fixtures), verified via isolated child-process import in a clean environment.
Expected-optional modules (rebar._mcp_auth, rebar.opcert_service.app, rebar.review_bot.app) must be attempted but recorded as skips only when their declared optional dependency is absent.
The import walk must be locally runnable without CI machinery (python scripts/check_import_walk.py, make import-walk) from any checkout with rebar installed.
Historical import regressions (e.g., scripts/alert_dedup bare import without sys.path insert) must be caught and prevented from being masked by earlier-sorted sibling scripts inserting the directory.
